declaredBy: Pedro installed the overnight window on 2026-10-01 ('Install it', for queued k3 nights that accumulate packed Night 7 runs); written by Claude before any slot was enqueued or played
ladder: S4 (plans/ROADMAP.md): Night 7 reliability on the phone, unattended. A cohort result, not a promotion; each won night may still be promoted on its own pack.

configuration.dials: all ten at 20 (10/20), the k3 binding's default Custom Night vector
configuration.seed: natural: the game's own wall clock at each night start, never pinned
configuration.venue: docs/evidence/venue-binding-hid-mediaprojection-20260930.json (passed by the night job since this commit)

commit: the commit that adds this file; the overnight window runs that checkout
command: apps/lab/overnight-window.py (fnaf2-overnight-window.timer, 01:30-07:00) -> companion-queue.py night jobs -> apps/lab/night-job.py -> packages/play/bin/phone/night-run.sh --live --confirm-live --label k3-ow-rNN --bundle <emitted fresh from the committed winner> --night 7 --serial <the lease's> --profile hid-mediaprojection --no-grade --venue-binding docs/evidence/venue-binding-hid-mediaprojection-20260930.json [--bt-audio on r05 and r06]
commandNote: No frame trace (a traced run is a measurement run) and no video grade (--no-grade); slots r01-r04 run without audio and r05-r06 retain the phone's A2DP mix, last, because a job failure ends the window and the audio link is the likeliest unattended failure. The window restores every phone setting it changes.

rules.counted: a slot counts once its campaign observes the night; a job refused before the runner (title, venue, power, lock, lease, window) is not a slot played and is re-queued as rNNb on a later night
rules.win: the executor's terminal sixam with its campaign proof, as the pack records it (Plan 12's terminalPass reads the same)
rules.death: the executor's terminal gameover; the cause is read later from the pack where it can be, otherwise UNKNOWN
rules.noTuning: the binding, the bundle emitter and the night-run path are not changed between slots; a change ends this cohort and starts a new predeclaration

prior: k3 reached 6 AM on 8 of 10 predeclared attended nights (docs/evidence/night7-cohort-k3-result-20260918.json). The model is not a predictor of a phone night here: its encounter rates match the phone's on full-06 but not which encounter comes when (docs/evidence/full06-occupancy-rates-20261001.json).
report: wins of slots played, deaths, refused jobs with reasons, each slot's pack id, and the exact commit; computed by `npm run evidence -- cohort docs/evidence/night7-cohort-k3-overnight-predeclaration-20261001.json` once the packs exist
